channel_contract.G: immediate fire/reset/refractory and resume same threshold policy: x-K+q*J(b)
channel_contract.J: stationary regenerative threshold policy envelope including all future firings
channel_contract.financial_scope: J/G are policy envelope and intervention obstacle; neither is a claimed exact He-Xiong financial Call/Put operator
channel_contract.first_passage_probability: drives mean-state reset/refractory and activity; not substituted for a Put value
channel_contract.free_ordinary: same pressure/FPT dynamics but gate features use scaled margin and raw-state transforms; separate two_gates is ordinary gated-RNN external control
channel_contract.gap: J-G; free stationary optimum nonnegative, value and first slope match at b; direct/fixed generally only value match

content_gate.ood: synthetic lengths32train/64test; irregular additionally3xdt; report ID/OOD separately
content_gate.real_data_scope: speaker-disjoint600FSDD recordings and MNIST images with literal query tokens; not language/video/foundation-model evidence
content_gate.rule: On each named task free_dual mean accuracy should be within2percentagepoints of best external baseline under the same search budget; this is a screening gate, not an equivalence test

cost_accounting.additional_costs: setup, validation, checkpoint IO, reporting, holdout evaluation, native model/owner execution, recovery separately measured and included in total
cost_accounting.budget_unit: 2 LR candidates each20CPU sec per model-task-seed; checkpoints may choose an earlier model but full search cost charged
cost_accounting.energy: not measured; no Joule or neuromorphic energy claim
cost_accounting.training_clock: process CPU includes minibatch sampling, forward/backward, gradient summaries, clipping, optimizer; complete update overrun counted

execution.outcome_changes_forbidden: no source/data/budget/hyperparameter changes after main outcomes; bugs require a new study identity and preserved prior evidence
execution.priority_reason: unblocks the predeclared native integration evaluation; all remaining jobs shuffled before outcomes

model_scope.certified_oracle: static scalar value, optimal boundary, first-passage terms and regenerative renewal reward; does not certify mean closure
model_scope.class: differentiable mean-state closure cell with exact stationary local boundary
model_scope.continuous_process_propagation: not exact and not timestep-consistent under repeated distribution collapse; closure001 independently measures this bias
model_scope.prohibition: Do not label mean closure as exact continuous-boundary stochastic flow, and do not interpret K*activity as real repeated-event cost

native_evaluation.causality: actual native STOP exits model step loop; initial durable state matched for individual channel interventions

cpu_cost_scenarios.interpretation: scenario conversion only; no observed monetary or energy cost inferred; shared training costs cancel only where both controllers use the same trained checkpoint
cpu_cost_scenarios.shared_setup: Each standalone deployment scenario conservatively pays the whole shared audit/load/report setup once, amortized over N; scenarios are alternatives and must not be summed as one bill.

native_evaluation.recovery: state serialization and real native child process resume; distinguish same Python object recreation from true interpreter restart scaling test
native_evaluation.reward: 1 if final predicted class correct, else0; net utility reward minus price*actual reads
native_evaluation.selection: owner controller coefficients frozen before test; no fitted-optimal controller claim
native_evaluation.training_charge: Complete per-search wait4 child CPU, including interpreter/import/setup/two LRs/validation/checkpoint/heldout costs; conservative lifecycle charge. Require EXECUTION.json for main study.

optimization.fixed_step_rule: 128-only snapshot is ineligible for primary selection; secondary choose LR by validation CE at exactly128, report missing arms without extrapolation
optimization.optimizer: Adam default betas, no weight decay
optimization.parameter_matching: same frontend/readout; external active backbone parameters within5percent; no dummy padding; report exact counts
optimization.selection: minimum validation CE over common CPU checkpoints only, then LRs; ties favor earlier CPU, then smaller LR

question: Does a task-trained stationary regenerative-boundary inductive bias improve heldout content or measured execution cost?

scaling.claim_scope: reference CPU implementations; not optimized CUDA FlashAttention/Mamba or neuromorphic hardware
scaling.environment: CPU only, single thread per process
scaling.timing: one warmup and three measured repetitions; root solve forward/backward separated

statistics.acceptance: all three: mean advantage>=.01, Holm adjusted p<=.05, paired interval lower>0
statistics.aggregation: no pooled cross-task sample-size weighting; macro task average descriptive only
statistics.confidence_interval: paired t nominal95percent with7df; not a simultaneous interval
statistics.contrast: free_dual minus comparison; first average two fixed tasks within eachseed, then across8seeds
statistics.core_three_seed_results: descriptive only, no strong significance claim
statistics.dataset_dependence: repeated FSDD recordings are not independent episodes; record source/speaker strata and do not use episode-level binomial CI as population evidence
statistics.missing_or_failed_run: preserve failure evidence; affected comparison incomplete and cannot pass; no silent deletion or retuning
statistics.test: two-sided exact sign-flip of eight paired seed differences; symmetry/sign-exchangeability assumption; Holm family of6
